EmailTemplate.description: Welcome email of the Partner Portal site (Administration, Emails): sent when a channel partner's login is created, with the username and the link to set the password.
EmailTemplate.name: Partner Portal Welcome
EmailTemplate.subject: Welcome to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Receiving_User.FirstName} {!Receiving_User.LastName},
Your login to the John Keells Properties Partner Portal has been created.
Your username: {!Receiving_User.Username}
Set your password here to get started: {!Community_Url}
The link works once and for a limited time. If it has expired, open the Partner Portal login page and choose "Forgot Password?" to get a new one.
Thanks, John Keells Properties
This is an automated message from the John Keells Properties Partner Portal. If you did not register as a channel partner, please ignore it.
